summary: A 30-ft Aermotor MC-24 tower in the Gila National Forest, dated 1933 by Forest Service sources; its steel cab was replaced in 1965.

facts.design: 30-ft Aermotor MC-24 steel tower; steel CL-100 series cab replaced the original 12x12 wooden cab in 1965
facts.agency: U.S. Forest Service, Gila National Forest (Black Range Ranger District)

visit.trail_note: Limited parking on Forest Road 226A serves the Continental Divide National Scenic Trail (Trail #74).

events.note: 30-ft Aermotor MC-24 steel tower constructed with a 12x12 wooden cab (Forest Service account, 2020 review); the register gives 1965
Original observation cab replaced with a steel CL-100-series cab; upper flight of stairs modified
Register says the lookout was constructed in 1965 on the existing Aermotor tower
Found not eligible in the 1988 thematic National Register review: loss of integrity of original design

corrections.why: Two sources date the 30-ft MC-24 tower to 1933; 1965 is the date of the steel cab replacement. The register's 1965 build date and 1934 caption conflict and need a human check before any change.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register dates the lookout's construction to 1965 and a photo caption gives 1934 for the MC-24 tower and cab. The Forest Service account and 2020 review place the tower in 1933 and the steel cab replacement in 1965.

sources.title: Lookout Mountain CDNST Trailhead
sources.publisher: Gila National Forest, U.S. Forest Service

notes_for_editor: Build-date conflict: the register says 1965 construction and captions the MC-24 tower and cab 1934; the Forest Service account and 2020 review say 1933 for the tower. The correction to 1933 is proposed for human review, not applied. Access: only the trailhead page was read; whether the cab is visitable is not confirmed. Staffing evidence is the 2020 review.
